title: Endovascular Management for Peripheral Arterial Disease of the Upper and Lower Extremities

issue: <p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The Local Coverage Determination (LCD) has been developed to create a policy consistent with current evidence for the endovascular management of peripheral arterial disease (PAD) for the upper and lower extremity. The LCD outlines limited coverage for this service with specific details under <strong><em>Coverage Indications, Limitations and/or Medical Necessity</em></strong>. Extracranial revascularization of the carotid artery, aortic and mesenteric disease will not be considered in this LCD. This LCD does not address patients who require inpatient treatment for PAD.</span></p>
issue_change:
<p>The Final LCD was modified based on comments received during the open comment period. The bibliography was expanded to include additional journal articles suggested by stakeholders during the open comment period. All articles included in the bibliography were reviewed; however, some do not have a direct reference in the LCD since it had no impact on coverage. Additionally, coverage was extended for Diamond Atherectomy with supporting documentation. In addition, for office-based endovascular surgery performed under conscious sedation or above, services will need to be performed in a setting that is safe, meets or exceeds state guidelines and is nationally accredited, if required, by the state or when no state guidelines exist. Coverage was clarified to emphasize that inpatient procedures are not affected by this LCD if deemed reasonable and necessary to perform at that site of service.</p>
<p>In the related Billing and Coding: Endovascular Management for Peripheral Arterial Disease of the Upper and Lower Extremities A60247 article, changes were made due to the 2026 Annual/Quarter 1 CPT/HCPCS Code Update.</p>
